highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds modern .NET UWP controls and an experimental image-comparison package.
highlights_body: This unreleased line also corrects runtime-effect uniform initialization, Windows image-decoding crashes and GPU texture-edge sampling. Linux x86 native assets are no longer included.

breaking.title: Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture
breaking.body: Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Applications deployed on 32-bit x86 Linux must move to a supported architecture before upgrading.

bullets.detail: The separate SkiaSharp.Testing package compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and produces difference images. Opt in to experimental diagnostic SKIA4001; returned difference images are caller-owned.

SkiaSharp.Views.UWP adds CPU SKXamlCanvas and ANGLE-backed SKSwapChainPanel controls targeting net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0, with a declared Windows minimum of 10.0.17763.0. SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.UWP supplies UWP integration for x86, x64 and ARM64. This does not restore legacy uap10.0 support; drawing surfaces remain control-managed.

Fixes process crashes when libjpeg or libpng recovers from decoding errors in clang-built Windows x64 natives, including malformed JPEGs passed to SKCodec.Create and lazy non-JPEG images in PDF output. Other architectures and MSVC builds are unchanged.
SKGLView uses a statically expressed Window binding instead of a runtime string path, removing the associated trimming warning without changing the binding's behavior.

Filtered texture-subset sampling clamps slightly inward to avoid undefined exterior texels, and unsafe edge-copy shortcuts are disabled. Texture-edge pixels may change; this affects Ganesh, not CPU or Graphite rendering.
The intended blur configuration now reaches Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths rather than the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ.

New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers start at zero, and Reset clears the existing buffer in place instead of replacing it with uninitialized storage. Repeated resets no longer allocate a native buffer and wrapper.
Updates the bundled native engine with upstream fixes within milestone 159, without changing managed bindings or advancing the Skia milestone.

contributor_summaries.taublast: Corrected runtime-effect uniform initialization and reset behavior, and disposed test data snapshots.
contributor_summaries.bhall-ctre: Made the MAUI SKGLView window binding trim-safe.
contributor_summaries.FoggyFinder: Added modern .NET UWP controls and native integration.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery and Views projects to the Windows sample solution.
contributor_summaries.SimonCropp: Fixed Windows x64 crashes during JPEG and PNG error recovery.
